post.title: Why MAA renewers paid 5.3% more as new leases fell 6%
post.ig:
At one big landlord, new tenants paid 6% less and renewing tenants paid 5.3% more (MAA, Q3 2026).
The US rental vacancy rate hit 7.6% in Q3 2026, per the Census, and 39.8% of Zillow rental listings offered a deal in April 2026.
In September 2026 the median vacant unit took 34 days to lease (Apartment List).
Our math: a 5.3% raise on the $1,541 Census median asking rent is about $980 a year; 34 empty days is about $1,722 of lost rent.
Sources: US Census Bureau, MAA Q3 2026 results, Zillow, Apartment List.
